title: Genetic ancestry data — Ancestry estimation metrics
description: One element is one participant's estimated genetic ancestry (file ofh_imputed_sample_ancestry).

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D102). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).
